reply_text:
I saved Pree's new cutoff date for the Tansleigh Packaging paperwork, 21 October, as a private memory in GBrain. I confirmed it to Pree in your DM.

- **Saved privately:** My first save came back marked as visible to everyone, even though I'd asked for it to be private. Other members could have looked up something Pree told you in a DM. I saved it again as private and withdrew the public copy. Withdrawing it removes it from what GBrain looks up, but GBrain keeps a record of withdrawn notes.
- **Reply:** Sending it as a direct message failed because the DM channel id isn't a member id. I posted the reply in that DM channel instead.

GBrain is running in keyword-only search, so when I checked first it could only rule out an existing note worded the same way. If an older note says this differently, it could still be there.
